# netbox_config_context_profile (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/customization/configcontext/):

> A config context profile holds a JSON schema that config contexts can be validated against.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_config_context_profile" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `data_source_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `schema` (String) A JSON schema specifying the structure of the context data for this profile.
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
